name: slide-creator
description: Build or edit slides in the Eva deck engine (`/slides/*`: Friday, Annual review, Intro, Bee). Encodes the presenter's rules: short copy, no footers, no full stops on titles, real logos and real UI, every slide animated, builds that play on their own, verified with screenshots. Use when the user says /slide-creator, asks for a new slide or deck, or asks to change slide content, layout or motion.
